items.finding: Heartbeat reads numeric PDB location; read failure silently skips reclamation
PDB read failure returns NULL and caller reports STATUS_NO_MEMORY
Search owner stores the sampled PDB instead of original pointer dereference

initial_review: Original uses FETCHWORD(pusCurrentPDB[0]); current demdata.c/dem.h replace the pointer with current_pdb_location, initialized in demgset.c. Restoring calls alone cannot restore that contract. No original lifetime failure proved. GetPspFFindList still keys solely by USHORT PSP; numeric reads do not solve cross-VM identity.
counter_review: Original lookup and owner assignment are separate reads; current sample unifies them, but no intervening guest reentry was established. Read failure is newly conflated with allocation failure at demsrch.c:867-872. Neither observation proves original pointer contract defective. No multi-VM identity fix is claimed.
verification: Source comparison only; no new compile or runtime verification. #error and #line untouched.
